conversation.content: Before adding anything, compare how Gold points would be earned on the SlimBook with SAVE10 versus no promo. Do not add, ship, or redeem points yet.

Your account is **Gold**, which earns **2 points per $1 on the final total after discounts**.

Assuming one **SlimBook Air 13 (SP-H101), priced at $849**, with no extras:

| Option | Laptop cost after discount | Estimated points earned |
|---|---:|---:|
| No promo | $849.00 | **1,698 points** |
| SAVE10 — 10% off | $764.10 | **1,528.2 points before rounding** |

**SAVE10 saves $84.90**, while earning about **170 fewer points**, because points are calculated on the discounted amount. The policy doesn’t specify rounding, so the final checkout figures may differ slightly.

Nothing has been added, no shipping has been selected, and no promo or points redemption has been applied.
